name: 08360 · Vineland, NJ
findings: ZIP 08360 (Vineland) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08360 (Vineland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08360 (Vineland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.
